proposal.insert_after: The [complete Aion telling](../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md#aion-differentiated-return) **figures** differentiated return through the initial ego/Self inflation problem and the final quaternio circulation: Jung’s A/B/C/D process changes an unconscious totality into a conscious one (CW9ii §§43–49, 408–413). His explicit modern reconstruction of the Shadow Quaternio keeps historical reception visible. The native x→X→x and IS→AM derivations remain Taylor’s; the “becoming indivisible” attribution remains separately unresolved.
